DIAGNOSIS READY: Flexor Digitorum Profundus Rupture of the Right Ring Finger.

The mechanism of a jersey pull causing hyperextension, combined with your inability to flex the distal interphalangeal joint and the resting extension of the finger, confirms a rupture of the flexor tendon. The X-ray rules out fracture, and the clinical exam is diagnostic.
